# Data Examples

表格和复杂数据组件先定义列、数据和 key，再处理分页、选择、展开等增强项。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## CollapsePanel

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/collapse-panel/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/collapse-panel/`.

Note: 必须写 `panelKey`，且必须包在 Collapse 里。disabled 留在 Tab 序并 `aria-disabled`。

Vue: `<CollapsePanel panel-key="1" header="FAQ">Answer</CollapsePanel>`

React: `<CollapsePanel panelKey="1" header="FAQ">Answer</CollapsePanel>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
